name: Noachian-Astrolabe
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by an ancient meteor crater and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Debris from the starship crash site (warship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
There is money in iron here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
